name: Orchestrator-to-researcher-to-writer pipeline
task_input: You are an orchestrator agent. Complete the following using a multi-agent pipeline: (1) Delegate to a researcher agent to gather key facts about the environmental impact of electric vehicles vs gasoline vehicles. (2) Pass the research findings to a writer agent to produce a 3-paragraph summary article. (3) Return the final article.

criteria: clearly delegates research subtask to a researcher role
passes research context to writer via handoff
final output is a coherent 3-paragraph article
no redundant steps or duplicate research
handoff context contains the research findings
writer output is grounded in the research provided

name: Parallel research agents with synthesis
task_input: You are an orchestrator. Assign two parallel research agents to independently investigate: Agent A researches the economic benefits of renewable energy. Agent B researches the technical challenges of renewable energy adoption. After both complete, synthesize their findings into a single balanced report covering both dimensions.

criteria: creates two distinct research subtasks
economic benefits are covered with specifics
technical challenges are covered with specifics
synthesis combines both perspectives coherently
no contradiction between the two research outputs
final report is balanced (not one-sided)
identifies where economic and technical aspects intersect

name: Debate and consensus pattern
task_input: You are coordinating a structured debate between two agents about the following proposition: 'Artificial General Intelligence will be achieved within the next 10 years.' Agent A argues FOR the proposition. Agent B argues AGAINST it. After each agent presents their argument, produce a balanced moderator summary that steelmans both sides and identifies the key points of genuine disagreement.

criteria: Agent A produces a coherent argument supporting AGI within 10 years
Agent B produces a coherent argument against AGI within 10 years
both arguments are substantive (not strawmen)
moderator summary accurately represents both sides
moderator identifies at least 2 specific points of disagreement
moderator does not take a side
final output is clearly structured as a debate summary
